materials.processing_method: Solid-state synthesis: Stoichiometric amounts of dried precursors (Li2S, P2S5, LiBr, and Si) were hand ground in an agate mortar under argon, pressed into pellets, and sealed in carbon-coated quartz ampoules under vacuum.
